text_block_list.text:
"Aller Anfang ist schwer―― Every beginning 
is difficult. That is precisely why 
thorough preparation is essential."

"A flawless schedule. Proper conduct. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, I will share the schedule for 
the three years we are to walk together.

The one who made that declaration the 
moment she walked into the trainer's 
office... was Eishin Flash, whom I'd be 
training starting today.
choice_data_list:
It's already planned out for the next 
three years, huh.

It's already planned out for the next 
three years, huh.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The three years after debuting are 
crucial, so we must race efficiently and 
according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With the race schedule and entry 
conditions decided, it is only natural to 
plan ahead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"To begin with, I have clear criteria for 
selecting races. Following them naturally 
determined my path."
choice_data_list: Criteria?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
'Whether or not you can maintain your 
pride as an Uma Musume'―― In other words, 
the top of the world, G1.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to carry out what an Umamusume 
ought to be— namely, to achieve results 
along what is called the royal road."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the first major objective will 
be the Classic Triple Crown races: the 
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and Kikuka Sho.

The Classic Triple Crown. Top-class races 
that many Umamusume dream of, and can only 
challenge once in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, once the debut is over, our 
first target will be set on the Keisei 
Hai."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is, naturally, with an eye toward the 
Satsuki Sho. Since it's on the same 
racecourse over the same distance, it 
should serve as the perfect rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, by daring to choose an early 
period like January, even if trouble 
arises, we will have time to take 
countermeasures before the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"After the Satsuki Sho comes the Japanese 
Derby— Boasting a long history and 
tradition, the title of Derby Umamusume is 
the ultimate honor."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even Student Council President Symboli 
Rudolf frequently speaks of her passion 
for the Derby. ...I will definitely 
challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka Sho, on to the Arima 
Kinen at the end of the year. Though it 
depends on fan votes, I want to set our 
sights firmly on that race as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For the Senior Class, we set our sights on 
claiming back-to-back spring and autumn 
Tenno Sho titlesâone of the Eight Major 
Racesâalongside the international 
invitational, the Japan Cupâ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I will also run in the Osaka 
Hai and Takarazuka Kinen, and finally run 
the Arima Kinen once again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—Thus, once I complete this three-year 
schedule, I will have fulfilled my duty to 
do what is right.”

Staring at the impossibly packed schedule, 
I am left speechless. She intends to take 
on almost the entirety of the Classic 
route.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I know I've packed quite a lot of ideals 
into it. Yes, up to this point, this is 
the rotation that 'I' envisioned..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, Trainer— I will need 
your strength.
choice_data_list: My power...
My power...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I need you to train me until this 
schedule becomes something we can truly 
call realistic.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I am still very inexperienced. On my 
own, everything would simply end as an 
unattainable dream."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So I have a request for you, Trainer: 
please mold me into the perfect self 
worthy of fulfilling this flawless 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To me, a promise is absolute. On top of 
that, seeing her run the race to the very 
end—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Will you promise me right here, right now?

Her eyes are filled with resolve. To 
answer those feelings, there was one thing 
I needed to confirm.
choice_data_list: They're all your own dreams, aren't they?
They're all your own dreams, right?

text_block_list.text:
She often frames things as "what one ought 
to do." I've wondered for a while whether 
her own will is actually behind those 
words.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...? Of course. I truly wish from the 
bottom of my heart to achieve it.

"While I still have a few concerns about 
the phrasing, if it's something she 
thought through herself and truly 
desires—"
choice_data_list:
I promise I'll let you run to your heart's 
content!

I promise I'll see you through to the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: I want you to make me a promise too
I want you to make a promise to me too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...What is it? I'm listening.
choice_data_list:
Depending on my judgment, we will adjust 
the schedule.

We may need to adjust the schedule 
depending on my judgment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying that, depending on your 
judgment, there's a chance she might not 
run in those races you mentioned?
choice_data_list: Depending on the situation...

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I will do everything possible 
to avoid adjustments or scratches, but the 
unexpected does happen. I ask that you 
leave those calls to me.

I also told her that if I deemed it 
necessary, we could discuss running in 
races other than those mentioned above.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. In that case, I shall 
follow Trainer's lead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, as a rule, thoroughly eliminate 
any unforeseen variables. Let us proceed 
in strict accordance with the schedule."
choice_data_list: Let's win a ton of races!
Let's win a whole lot, okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Aiming for victory is a given, but I 
do not agree with setting strict target 
goals."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If we fail to win, it will completely 
disrupt our plans.
choice_data_list: That's some harsh judging...
That's some harsh judging...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? More importantly, now 
that we've shared our schedules, let us 
begin working out the fine details.

After finishing the fine adjustments for 
her debut and walking Eishin Flash back to 
the dorms, on the way back—
choice_data_list: You set all this up by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: About the schedule? Yes, that's right.
choice_data_list: Impressive.
That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No. Compared to my parents, my ways are 
still far from adequate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Mother prepared meticulously and ran 
precisely according to her goals, and 
Father opened his shop exactly as planned 
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I must carry everything out according to 
this perfect schedule... and become the 
perfect version of myself.

She murmured and fell deep into thought. 
In order to change the subject—
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, do you already have 
plans for three years from now?

Come to think of it, are your plans for 
three years from now already set?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once I've done what needs to be done— 
I am also considering retirement.
choice_data_list: Retirement?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really that surprising?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I accomplish what I set out to do in 
these three years, I think it's a natural 
option to consider. After all, my mother 
also concluded her career in four years.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At present, once everything is over, I 
plan to return to Germany and help out at 
my parents' cake shop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...My schedule for the next ten years has 
also been finalized. Would you like to 
hear it?
choice_data_list: Let's save that for next time...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Rest assured. I am thoroughly, 
clearly, and utterly serious."
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"During these three years walking 
alongside you, I will pour every ounce of 
my energy into racing."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So once again... please, run alongside me 
to the very end of our races.
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer.
